entity1.name: Artificial Intelligence
entity1.description: A branch of computer science that aims to create systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, and problem-solving.;;;Artificial Intelligence technologies, referring to systems or machines that perform tasks typically requiring human intelligence.;;;Artificial Intelligence, a field of computer science focused on creating systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence.;;;Artificial Intelligence systems that are used to collect and analyze large volumes of data.;;;Artificial Intelligence systems, which are computer systems designed to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence.;;;Artificial Intelligence systems, which are computational systems designed to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence.;;;Artificial Intelligence systems, which are computer systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence.;;;An artificial intelligence system that performs tasks or makes decisions.;;;An artificial intelligence system designed to perform tasks or make decisions.;;;Artificial Intelligence-based systems, tools, or innovations used in various applications and industries.;;;Artificial Intelligence, a field of computer science focused on creating systems that can perform tasks requiring human intelligence.;;;Artificial Intelligence technologies, which refer to systems or machines that perform tasks requiring human intelligence.;;;Technologies based on artificial intelligence, which involve systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence.

entity3.name: privacy
entity3.description: A principle referring to the right of individuals to control their personal information and maintain confidentiality.;;;The right of individuals to control their personal information and maintain confidentiality.;;;The rights of individuals to control and protect their personal information from unauthorized access or use.;;;A fundamental right that protects individuals from unauthorized intrusion into their personal lives.;;;The protection of personal information and data from unauthorized access or disclosure.

entity4.name: bias
entity4.description: A tendency or prejudice that can affect the fairness and objectivity of AI systems, often due to flawed data or design.;;;A tendency or prejudice that can lead to unfair or inaccurate outcomes, especially in the context of AI systems.;;;A systematic favoritism or prejudice, often unintentional, that can affect the fairness of AI systems.

entity5.name: accountability
entity5.description: The responsibility of individuals or organizations for the actions and decisions made by AI systems.;;;A principle or ethical concern related to responsibility and answerability for actions or decisions, particularly in the context of AI development.;;;The responsibility of individuals or organizations for their actions, particularly in the context of AI technologies.;;;The principle that individuals or organizations are responsible for their actions and decisions, especially in the context of AI development and deployment.

entity6.name: transparency
entity6.description: The quality of being open and clear about how AI systems operate, make decisions, and use data.;;;A principle referring to the clarity and openness of processes, especially in the context of AI development.;;;The quality of being open and honest about the processes, decisions, and operations of AI systems.
